content.short: MixBytes provides DeFi auditing to identify and prevent exploits in decentralized projects.
content.description: MixBytes aims to make DeFi more efficient and secure. Its auditing services cover investigations of logical errors, inconsistencies, and vulnerabilities, along with actionable recommendations to address each issue. A team of security engineers independently reviews the source code to audit the project architecture, check code against a vulnerabilities checklist, verify security model compliance, prepare a report, fix bugs, re-audit contracts, and issue a final code verification and public audit report. Clients include Aave, Yearn Finance, Curve, 1inch, PowerPool, and others.
content.meta: MixBytes is a DeFi auditing firm that spots and stops exploits in DeFi projects. Discover MixBytes and other Web3 Security Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
